semantics: Completion prerequisites remain stable across planned, in_progress, implemented and complete states. Complete requires source-bound evidence and completed prerequisites. Structural/hash checks do not attest test truth or production readiness.

nodes.purpose: Read-only exact SDK/lock verifier independent of lock generation.

tests.stimulus: Run verifier normally and with Python -O against changed, missing and extra SDK files; include ../ and drive-qualified lock paths.
tests.expected: Each invalid fixture exits nonzero without modifying the SDK or lock; unchanged exact set passes.
tests.oracle: Compare hashes and file set before/after; verifier test computes expected digests independently.

tests.stimulus: Simulate wrong archive digest, ignored Range, short body and interrupted extraction in existing acquisition scripts.
tests.expected: No incomplete tree is promoted; next run verifies a complete staged extraction instead of trusting Configure presence.
tests.oracle: Fixture HTTP responses and independently enumerated final files; do not depend on assert statements.

nodes.purpose: TLS-owned recordless boundary with precise provider capabilities.

tests.stimulus: Compile one host fixture and one provider against the same contract; request records-only provider in recordless mode.
tests.expected: Compatible fixtures link; unavailable recordless capability fails construction before input is accepted.
tests.oracle: Separate consumer build and explicit error observation.

tests.stimulus: Specify input bytes, secret event, peer parameters, cancellation and stale event token in a contract-only fixture.
tests.expected: Every borrow has one ending action; units, direction and generation have explicit types; no accepted prefix exceeds input.
tests.oracle: Review ownership table and compile negative type examples; these are design checks until executable types exist.

tests.stimulus: Normalize environment defaults and attempt an unauthorized trust/capability override before construction.
tests.expected: Typed effective options match the recorded normalized plan; unauthorized or unclassified changes fail before input/allocation.
tests.oracle: Independent selected-option/schema identity and caller allowlist; verify no post-hash native default was introduced.

nodes.purpose: Public owner for recordless TLS handshake operations.

tests.stimulus: Run a complete real certificate handshake in both roles with fragmented per-level bytes and bounded output.
tests.expected: Completion occurs once after configured peer/ALPN policy; no record-layer feed API is called.
tests.oracle: Independent expected SAN/ALPN and peer implementation; record event order and per-level byte hashes.

tests.stimulus: Use wrong SAN, untrusted CA, mismatched ALPN, cancellation and repeated calls after terminal failure.
tests.expected: No application-ready event; stable terminal error; all owned queues and secrets released once.
tests.oracle: Instrument allocation/free and event counters; do not infer authentication from traffic-secret availability.

tests.stimulus: Cancel or fail while a provider lease remains held, including an alert callback failure and a failed release callback.
tests.expected: Public entry closes before destruction; callback state remains live through provider cleanup; owned custody and secrets are disposed once after provider access ends.
tests.oracle: Instrument allocation lifetime and poisoning at each retained state in the real Zig/C owner; compare with native cleanup traces.

nodes.purpose: Bounded acknowledged event queue for bytes, secrets, peer parameters and completion.

tests.stimulus: Fill two event slots, borrow the head twice, then acknowledge tail or old-generation token.
tests.expected: Same head bytes/token remain stable; invalid acknowledgement changes neither queue nor custody.
tests.oracle: Finite custody model plus independently authored queue trace.

tests.stimulus: Acknowledge a secret before copying/deriving it; then cancel with a borrowed event and attempt reuse.
tests.expected: Early acknowledgement rejected; cancel invalidates borrow, clears owned secret, and forbids reuse of old owner identity.
tests.oracle: Fault-injected model and memory lifecycle instrumentation; abstract erasure alone is insufficient.

nodes.purpose: OpenSSL external QUIC TLS callback adapter, isolated from records BIO backend.

tests.stimulus: Run send callback with zero, partial and full capacity, then inject failure into each callback during an actual handshake.
tests.expected: Only accepted prefix is committed; callback failure becomes terminal; no deferred reference points at temporary callback memory.
tests.oracle: Current capability probe is preliminary evidence; use real handshake fault injection for completion.

tests.stimulus: Offer one input buffer, drive provider, and request another before release; deliver both directional secrets.
tests.expected: Borrow retained until matching release; at most one provider-held input; exact level/direction preserved for copied secrets.
tests.oracle: Poison released memory under instrumentation; compare callback trace to public wrapper events.

tests.stimulus: Reject a matching input release before retirement, then destroy the provider; separately inject wrong length and a duplicate after successful release.
tests.expected: Failed release retains stable custody; matching teardown retry can retire once; invalid or already-retired release cannot double-free or advance input.
tests.oracle: Instrument actual wrapper lease/allocation effects and callback order through provider destruction; standalone static probe is supporting evidence only.

nodes.purpose: Minimal internal ABI for the recordless backend.

tests.stimulus: Compile C and Zig ABI consumers with size, alignment and function-signature checks on native LLP64 and LP64.
tests.expected: Widths and nullable pointer/length rules agree or target is explicitly unsupported.
tests.oracle: C sizeof/alignof and Zig @sizeOf/@alignOf; link and invoke actual symbols.

tests.stimulus: Pass null with nonzero length, unknown level/direction, closed handle via safe test hooks, and output capacity zero.
tests.expected: Declared validation error without output mutation; freed raw pointers are never deliberately dereferenced.
tests.oracle: C ABI harness snapshots output and allocation ownership around each safe invalid call.

nodes.purpose: Adversarial conformance tests for the chosen QUIC boundary.

tests.stimulus: Exercise zero/partial/excess input consumption and reordered/duplicated acknowledgements against independent host/provider fixtures.
tests.expected: Overconsumption poisons owner; valid retry preserves bytes; stale acknowledgement never retires another event.
tests.oracle: Expected event traces authored independently; compare with bounded custody model.

tests.stimulus: Run real client/server recordless handshake with bad identity, ALPN, parameters and fatal alert.
tests.expected: Negative policy denies readiness; both success roles finish with correct directional traffic keys.
tests.oracle: Use independently configured peer identity and packet decrypt check; symbol/ClientHello probes cannot satisfy this case.

tests.stimulus: Queue one-byte fragments beyond a per-drive input budget, then process permitted and forbidden post-handshake CRYPTO after local completion.
tests.expected: Budget exhaustion defers local work without EOF or starvation; allowed post-handshake bytes obey normal custody; forbidden input fails without application plaintext delivery.
tests.oracle: Compare scheduler wakeups, byte retirement and public events to an independently specified trace; retain malformed-input and cancellation results.

nodes.purpose: Platform-specific backend discovery, linkage and runtime staging.

tests.stimulus: Build Windows and proposed POSIX targets with missing SDK, wrong architecture and path containing spaces.
tests.expected: Qualified native target builds; unsupported or mismatched target fails with actionable reason.
tests.oracle: Native link/run smoke per target; cross-compilation alone is insufficient.

tests.stimulus: Place an incompatible same-name library on search path while specifying locked SDK.
tests.expected: Resolver/staging chooses verified artifact or fails; recorded runtime provenance matches intended SDK.
tests.oracle: Capture loaded module identity and compare file digests; test outside development directory.

tests.stimulus: Build lean and optional-adapter profiles; change a runtime-only setting and enable a disabled-dependency tripwire.
tests.expected: Lean graph does not configure/import the optional backend; runtime-only changes do not silently alter compiled feature identity.
tests.oracle: Independent graph tripwire, clean consumer and artifact/build-plan hashes with recorded producer version.

nodes.purpose: POSIX demonstration transport matching the public Driver contract.

tests.stimulus: Drive nonblocking read/write with EINTR, EAGAIN, short transfer, clean EOF and hard error.
tests.expected: Driver receives distinct outcomes and exact transferred prefix; callbacks never block or retry forever.
tests.oracle: Injected syscall shim with finite call budget; real loopback test separately.

tests.stimulus: Cancel during connect/read/write and cycle IPv4/IPv6 sockets repeatedly.
tests.expected: Host closes each descriptor exactly once; no descriptor growth; caller buffer released on completion.
tests.oracle: Descriptor counts and transport ownership trace before/after each case.

nodes.purpose: Compile/link ABI contract tests across supported targets.

tests.stimulus: Compare C header and Zig extern scalar widths, pointer shapes and constructor argument order.
tests.expected: Compile/link/invocation agree on every supported native target.
tests.oracle: C-produced ABI constants and separate Zig consumer.

tests.stimulus: Link a fixture library with deliberately incompatible ABI version or signature guard.
tests.expected: Compatibility check rejects mismatch before normal operations.
tests.oracle: Known wrong-library fixture; do not use an unsafe call to discover stack corruption.

tests.stimulus: Supply declared target capability, unknown runtime observation, and runtime request for an omitted compiled branch.
tests.expected: A declaration is never treated as observed usability; unknown/absent required capability fails with a specific reason.
tests.oracle: Separately authored target/observation/compiled-capability fixtures; native ABI/runtime tests remain independent.

nodes.purpose: Versioned immutable credential configuration for new connections.

tests.stimulus: Rotate credential configuration while old and new handshakes run.
tests.expected: Existing owners retain original credential version; new owners receive new version; last release destroys retired version.
tests.oracle: Certificate fingerprint per peer and exact reference/free counters.

tests.stimulus: Attempt rotation with missing key, invalid chain or allocation failure.
tests.expected: Previously active version remains usable; failed candidate resources are released.
tests.oracle: Independent pre/post configuration fingerprint and leak instrumentation.

tests.stimulus: Change terminal context and logical credential locator while existing/new TLS owners coexist.
tests.expected: Ambient context cannot mutate existing credentials; explicitly accepted rotation uses distinct retained versions.
tests.oracle: Old/new credential fingerprints and owner lifetimes; no secret bytes in plan or diagnostic output.

nodes.purpose: Explicit identity, trust and revocation policy profile.

tests.stimulus: Require revocation status; supply revoked, unknown, expired-cache and unavailable service outcomes.
tests.expected: Profile denies readiness unless its explicit policy accepts available evidence; no silent downgrade.
tests.oracle: Fixed certificate/status fixtures and injected clock; inspect stable decision reason.

tests.stimulus: Validate DNS and IP identities across trust rotation and certificate time boundaries.
tests.expected: Decision matches configured identity type and trust version; no application authorization claim is inferred.
tests.oracle: Separate expected identities and fixed wall-clock instants; no network-dependent oracle.

tests.stimulus: Resolve a logical service to a new address while retaining explicit expected identity; supply misleading context metadata.
tests.expected: Routing/context does not authenticate the peer or bypass trust, hostname/IP, ALPN or application authorization policy.
tests.oracle: Independent expected peer identity and negative certificate/policy fixtures, with metadata changes isolated.

nodes.purpose: Measure and constrain provider allocation and work under adversarial input.

tests.stimulus: Feed large chains, repeated fragments and many simultaneous handshakes under declared quotas.
tests.expected: Peak provider and wrapper allocations/work are measured separately; enforced quotas terminate boundedly.
tests.oracle: Allocator/process measurements and callback operation budget; BIO size is not total heap.

tests.stimulus: Fail each allocation ordinal during construction, progress and teardown.
tests.expected: No leak, double free or post-terminal delivery; preexisting owners remain valid.
tests.oracle: Allocator ledger and sanitizers/available native diagnostics with recorded limitations.

nodes.purpose: Run a recorded multi-provider/platform TLS qualification matrix.

tests.stimulus: Run both roles across recorded provider/platform combinations with custom ALPN and identity failures.
tests.expected: All required cells pass; missing tools/platforms are explicit unqualified cells.
tests.oracle: Pinned independent peer commands and full exit/output receipts.

tests.stimulus: Exercise shutdown, partial records, backpressure and provider upgrade regression.
tests.expected: Authenticated closure distinguished from truncation; pending bytes preserved; prior compatibility profile retained or versioned.
tests.oracle: Wire/application hashes, EOF classification and before/after source/backend identities.

tests.stimulus: Compare baseline/candidate shared TLS artifact across all declared consumers, including one missing or failed cell.
tests.expected: Coverage gaps block promotion; pre-existing/new/unattributed diagnostics remain visible; no implicit consumer repin.
tests.oracle: Exact consumer list, retained dual-stream outputs and independent baseline/candidate identities.

nodes.purpose: Measure handshake/read/write scheduling cost and resource use.

tests.stimulus: Measure cold/warm handshakes, fragmented records and many concurrent owners.
tests.expected: Report distributions, allocations and environment with identical authentication settings.
tests.oracle: Independent plaintext checks outside timed region; timer resolution recorded.

tests.stimulus: Cancel at worst observed queue depth and certificate size.
tests.expected: Cancellation latency/work stays within declared measured envelope or fails the stated target.
tests.oracle: Injected scheduling trace and independent elapsed/work counters; no unmeasured universal bound.

nodes.purpose: Translate ordered per-level CRYPTO and TLS events into key installation and peer-parameter decisions.

tests.stimulus: Consume real TLS bytes/secrets/parameters through adapter in both roles.
tests.expected: Correct level and direction reach packet crypto; event acknowledged only after bounded custody succeeds.
tests.oracle: TLS contract conformance suite plus independent packet decrypt and event ledger.

tests.stimulus: Force queue exhaustion, unsupported suite, stale token and unit-conversion overflow.
tests.expected: No byte loss, early readiness or wrapped deadline; terminal versus retryable errors remain distinct.
tests.oracle: Snapshot queues and per-level offsets; boundary clock values checked with integer oracle.

tests.stimulus: Select recordless transport through host configuration while provider only supports records or required capability is unknown.
tests.expected: Fail explicitly before CRYPTO acceptance; no record tunneling or weaker-security fallback.
tests.oracle: Independent capability fixture and event/byte counters proving no premature provider input.

tests.stimulus: Exhaust TLS local input-work allowance while QUIC already owns more admissible contiguous CRYPTO; then deliver post-handshake Application-level CRYPTO.
tests.expected: Adapter schedules deferred local work without requiring another datagram; no busy loop, EOF substitution, duplicate readiness or application-plaintext routing occurs.
tests.oracle: Independent host event trace with no new network input, bounded scheduler turns, level-specific byte accounting and terminal mapping.

nodes.purpose: Prove the actual TLS-owned recordless provider interoperates with QUIC packet custody.

tests.stimulus: Real handshake with lost Initial, reordered Handshake and accepted Retry.
tests.expected: Contiguous CRYPTO delivered once; packet-number history retained; both peers authenticate according to role.
tests.oracle: Independent expected identity, per-space sent/received ledger and packet trace.

tests.stimulus: Use malformed/role-invalid peer parameters, wrong SAN/ALPN and cancellation at every pending event.
tests.expected: No application release; cleanup bounded and once-only; stable mapped error.
tests.oracle: Separate expected error/event trace; no key-availability shortcut.

nodes.purpose: Protect and open short-header 1-RTT packets.

tests.stimulus: Protect/open short headers using independent known-answer material at packet-number length boundaries.
tests.expected: Exact wire bytes match; nonce uses full number; authenticated plaintext matches.
tests.oracle: Published vectors where available plus independently produced cross-implementation vectors.

tests.stimulus: Truncate sample, corrupt tag/reserved bits, exceed usage limit and overlap scratch buffers.
tests.expected: Rejected input cannot commit authenticated state; scratch behavior follows documented pre/post-copy contract.
tests.oracle: Pre/post buffer and replay-history snapshots; independent nonce uniqueness ledger.

nodes.purpose: Own directional key generations and retirement.

tests.stimulus: Reorder old/new-phase packets and perform simultaneous directional updates after confirmation.
tests.expected: Each direction advances under its own rules; bounded old-key retention; no nonce reuse.
tests.oracle: Generation/packet-number ledger and independent peer decrypt.

tests.stimulus: Forge apparent phase change, initiate too early, or exhaust AEAD usage budget.
tests.expected: Unauthenticated data cannot advance keys; unsafe send fails before encryption.
tests.oracle: Snapshot generation/key identifiers and sent-wire count; secret bytes excluded from logs.

nodes.purpose: Coordinate Initial, Handshake and Application sent histories and one next-deadline result.

tests.stimulus: Schedule equal deadlines across spaces; discard Handshake keys with bytes still in flight.
tests.expected: One next timer; discarded packets debit flight exactly once; no cross-space ACK effect.
tests.oracle: Independent integer accounting and explicit event order.

tests.stimulus: ACK after deliberately skipped packet numbers; compare packet/time thresholds and Application ACK delay.
tests.expected: Selected RFC interpretation is documented and regression matches it; current local skipped-number rule reviewed explicitly.
tests.oracle: RFC 9002 section 6.1.1 and independent peer trace, not current test expectations alone.

nodes.purpose: Schedule Application acknowledgments under a documented policy.

tests.stimulus: Receive out-of-order Application packets near delay deadline with more ranges than capacity.
tests.expected: Policy bounds delay and ranges; loss of an older range does not erase newer obligations.
tests.oracle: Independent receive set and timer oracle with exact-before/at/after times.

tests.stimulus: Prepare ACK, receive another packet, fail send, then commit stale ticket.
tests.expected: New obligation survives; failed send consumes none; cross-owner token rejected if public API permits exchange.
tests.oracle: Generation ledger and injected host send outcomes.

nodes.purpose: Single-owner connection event reducer and capability gate.

tests.stimulus: Enumerate events in handshaking, active, closing, draining and closed states.
tests.expected: Only permitted transitions occur; application readiness requires all policy gates.
tests.oracle: Independent transition table; each rejected event preserves relevant state.

tests.stimulus: Tie timeout, peer close, local cancel and handshake completion at the same timestamp.
tests.expected: Documented precedence gives one terminal owner; no revival or double release.
tests.oracle: Event permutation harness and owned-resource ledger.

tests.stimulus: Overload diagnostic sink and attempt callback reentry during failure and cancellation.
tests.expected: Bounded telemetry cannot change accepted protocol state or leak owned secret/plaintext buffers; reentry obeys declared rejection.
tests.oracle: Protocol-state snapshot plus sink operation/byte budget and redaction fixtures.

nodes.purpose: Coordinate decrypt, CID checks, frame preflight and commit across components.

tests.stimulus: Place a valid ACK/CRYPTO frame before a later malformed frame or unsent ACK claim.
tests.expected: Whole packet semantic admission fails without partial ACK, replay or CRYPTO commit.
tests.oracle: Snapshot all participating components, not only parser cursor.

tests.stimulus: Deliver coalesced packet with failed authentication followed by valid packet and mismatched CID.
tests.expected: Boundary iteration follows declared rules; path credit counted once per attributed datagram.
tests.oracle: Independent datagram boundary list, CID routing decision and path byte ledger.

nodes.purpose: Plan an immutable datagram with all capacity and policy checks before transport submission.

tests.stimulus: Prepare datagram then return would-block, known failure, success and ambiguous host result.
tests.expected: Accounting commits only per documented outcome; exposed packet numbers never encrypt changed plaintext.
tests.oracle: Immutable plan hash, nonce history and custody/congestion/amplification ledger.

tests.stimulus: Make queued arrivals or PTO state change between planning and attempted commit.
tests.expected: Stale plan rejected or validated transactionally; current ACK obligations survive.
tests.oracle: Generation snapshots for every participant and injected event ordering.

nodes.purpose: Encode/decode STREAM, RESET_STREAM and STOP_SENDING with bounded lengths.

tests.stimulus: Encode/decode FIN-only, maximum legal offsets, role/direction IDs and each truncation.
tests.expected: Exact checked length; errors restore cursor/output per contract.
tests.oracle: Independent byte corpus and arithmetic oracle.

tests.stimulus: Decode RESET final size and STREAM offset+length overflow without applying state.
tests.expected: Syntax errors rejected; semantic final-size decision delegated explicitly.
tests.oracle: Parser state snapshots and separate stream-state fixture.

nodes.purpose: Model bidirectional/unidirectional stream send/receive lifecycle.

tests.stimulus: Reorder data/FIN/reset across all role/direction stream kinds.
tests.expected: Ordered bytes delivered at most once; final size cannot change after commitment.
tests.oracle: Independent interval set and lifecycle table.

tests.stimulus: Cancel a stream with retransmissions outstanding, then deliver late data and ACK.
tests.expected: No revived delivery; custody retired under declared reset/ACK rules exactly once.
tests.oracle: Application byte log and allocation/range ownership ledger.

nodes.purpose: Track stream and connection receive/send credit.

tests.stimulus: Receive sparse offsets, duplicate bytes and reset with final size above highest received offset.
tests.expected: Charge aggregate highest offsets including reset delta; duplicates add no credit consumption.
tests.oracle: Integer sum over per-stream high-water marks.

tests.stimulus: Reorder credit updates and exhaust integer/stream limits.
tests.expected: Limits remain monotonic; overflow fails before mutation; closed-stream accounting retained as specified.
tests.oracle: Independent bounded counter oracle and complete pre/post snapshots.

nodes.purpose: Define datagram I/O results and buffer lifetimes independent of OS sockets.

tests.stimulus: Return would-block, short/ambiguous send, receive truncation and invalid byte count.
tests.expected: Only declared atomic datagram success is committed; invalid outcomes fail explicitly.
tests.oracle: Fake host with separate datagram ledger and callback count budget.

tests.stimulus: Attempt callback reentry or retain borrowed datagram after return.
tests.expected: Contract violation detected by debug/test hooks; owned copies survive required completion boundary.
tests.oracle: Poisoned temporary buffers and reentry guard harness; release behavior documented.

tests.stimulus: Move project/artifact roots and inject alternate host address/time capabilities without changing logical service identity.
tests.expected: No hardcoded workspace path or builder observation authorizes runtime operation; explicit resolved inputs govern behavior.
tests.oracle: Separate build/runtime host fixtures and relocated clean consumer with the same intended configuration.

nodes.purpose: Demultiplex datagrams and schedule bounded active connections.

tests.stimulus: Flood unknown CIDs and exhaust connection/global per-peer quotas.
tests.expected: Admission remains bounded; no TLS allocation before required routing/admission checks.
tests.oracle: Allocation and operation counters tied to input datagrams.

tests.stimulus: Schedule busy and quiet connections then cancel listener with sends pending.
tests.expected: Declared scheduling bound/fairness holds; each owner releases once and routing expires correctly.
tests.oracle: Deterministic network scheduler with independent ready-set and resource ledger.

tests.stimulus: Attach Contextz-style unknown/malformed/stale observations to service attribution while processing unknown CIDs.
tests.expected: Metadata remains separate from routing/admission/peer authority; invalid metadata cannot grant connection/path credit.
tests.oracle: Independent identity/admission ledger; distinguish absent context from malformed context and peer failure.

nodes.purpose: Deterministic loss, duplication, delay and reordering scheduler.

tests.stimulus: Replay fixed seed with loss, duplicates, delay and equal-time events.
tests.expected: Byte-for-byte event trace and terminal state reproduce.
tests.oracle: Golden trace independent of protocol implementation and stable tie-break ordering.

tests.stimulus: Enable permanent loss then minimize a failing finite trace.
tests.expected: No false liveness claim; event budget terminates with explicit reason; minimized trace retains failure.
tests.oracle: Finite action count and replay of minimized trace.

nodes.purpose: Challenge/response validation for a newly observed path.

tests.stimulus: NAT rebind with same CID and forged PATH_RESPONSE on unvalidated address.
tests.expected: New path has separate credit; only matching outstanding challenge validates it.
tests.oracle: Per-address byte/challenge ledger and injected random challenge source.

tests.stimulus: Expire challenge while two candidate paths compete.
tests.expected: Expired response cannot revive candidate; active path selection deterministic and bounded.
tests.oracle: Injected time and explicit candidate lifecycle table.

nodes.purpose: Bound datagram sizes and manage PMTU probes.

tests.stimulus: Drop probes above a threshold, report EMSGSIZE and change destination address.
tests.expected: Payload estimate falls back under policy; new path does not inherit unsafe MTU.
tests.oracle: Known simulated path ceiling and host result trace.

tests.stimulus: Lose probe amid ordinary congestion loss and ambiguous ICMP input.
tests.expected: Probe outcome and congestion event remain separate; unauthenticated signal cannot force arbitrary unsafe size.
tests.oracle: Independent probe registry and packet-flight accounting.

nodes.purpose: CID issuance, retirement and stateless reset matching.

tests.stimulus: Retire current CID, repeat sequence, exceed active limit and reorder issuance.
tests.expected: Routing remains usable per policy; bounded CID/token storage; duplicate effects idempotent.
tests.oracle: Independent sequence/routing set and allocation ledger.

tests.stimulus: Receive reset-looking unauthenticated packet with wrong or matching issued reset token.
tests.expected: Only eligible token/context terminates; no token bytes appear in diagnostic logs.
tests.oracle: Independent fixed tokens, equality test instrumentation and terminal event trace.

nodes.purpose: Version negotiation policy and version-specific packet dispatch.

tests.stimulus: Inject spoofed/reflected version lists and unsupported packet versions.
tests.expected: Policy rejects confusion without falling through to v1 parsing or unsafe downgrade.
tests.oracle: Independently authored negotiation corpus and selected-version log.

tests.stimulus: Replay current v1 codec vectors through version dispatch.
tests.expected: Existing v1 bytes and errors retained; supported versions explicitly enumerated.
tests.oracle: Frozen current vector corpus and separate dispatch table.

nodes.purpose: Run both endpoint roles against independently built QUIC peers.

tests.stimulus: Run handshake, streams, Retry, migration and key update against two independent peers in both roles.
tests.expected: Every required cell passes with source/backend/peer identities recorded.
tests.oracle: Pinned peer commands and application byte hashes; skipped cells are unqualified.

tests.stimulus: Inject loss, backpressure and closure failures; terminate stalled peer processes.
tests.expected: Bounded timeout, captured reason and complete cleanup; failure remains failure in aggregate.
tests.oracle: Process/socket ledger, monotonic deadline and retained stderr/exit code.

tests.stimulus: Run QUIC consumer qualification twice for the same candidate; then supply changed inputs, an interrupted host-promotion receipt or one missing declared consumer.
tests.expected: Runner emits fresh scoped evidence without publishing or repinning; incomplete coverage cannot report adoption complete. Host maintenance remains the reconciliation owner.
tests.oracle: Independent declared-consumer/input ledger and retained outputs; verify qualification changes no dependency pin or installed selector.

nodes.purpose: Mutation/fuzz entry points for packet and frame parsers.

tests.stimulus: Mutate each packet/frame truncation, offset limit and cross-level dispatch.
tests.expected: No crash, unbounded work or state mutation on rejected admission.
tests.oracle: Independent bounded input generator, operation counters and snapshot oracle.

tests.stimulus: Replay minimized saved crashes with compiler/source hashes.
tests.expected: Failure reproduces before fix and is rejected safely afterward; corpus remains versioned.
tests.oracle: Standalone replay entry point independent of fuzz discovery loop.

nodes.purpose: Measure throughput, latency and owned memory at declared capacities.

tests.stimulus: Sweep payload, connections, loss and backpressure within configured capacities.
tests.expected: Report latency/throughput/memory distributions and correctness with environment details.
tests.oracle: Application hashes outside timing and independent process memory measurements.

tests.stimulus: Run repeated cancel/reconnect cycles at capacity boundary.
tests.expected: Memory returns to declared steady-state envelope; no growing retained custody.
tests.oracle: Long-run allocation/connection ledger; state limits and warmup separated from measured samples.
